notes: Literal count: 208 color literals in styles.css lines 1101-2240 (regex #hex{3,8} | rgb[a]() | hsl[a]()); 208 entries written, 1:1 by (line, occurrence). Named colors: every hit of white/black/gold/cream in the range is inside a comment or 'white-space'; 'transparent' used as a value was excluded per the brief. No hsl() in range.

Most of the range already reads var(--amber|--chalk|--chalk-dim|--maple|--maple-line|--tunnel|--ink|--whistle|--ok); those are not counted here but a theme reaches them through the :root tokens (lines 9-18).

Three sub-palettes live in this range: (1) Hot Hand overlay, an amber-to-white heat ramp on a warm-black scrim; (2) the Tribune, deliberately off-palette warm-black ink #1b1611 on cream with a spot red #a13c2c and bronze twine; (3) the Daily brass plaque in goldenrod #E89A1C / #F8B647 / #9E5A0F.

Tribune roles map onto ink/ink-2/paper/paper-2/line-paper, but its ink is warm black, not the riso navy #232A4E. If one theme sets --t-ink for both the riso slips and the Tribune they will converge; consider whether the Tribune needs its own newspaper sub-tokens. It already has two local vars, --np-ink and --np-paper (1306-1307), but ~40 literals repeat the same rgb(27,22,17) and #1b1611 instead of using them.

Judgment calls to review: (a) #a13c2c Tribune spot red classified offset (second print ink), not bad; (b) #3fae5a green used to mark the viewer (duel-banner.you, arena-merank, lg-me) classified you, and as a selected-option state (lg-fmt.on/lg-rnd.on) classified accent; the spec lists #3FAE5A under good; (c) Daily plaque frame lines in #9E5A0F / rgba(232,154,28) classified metal even though the spec lists those hexes under accent-edge, because they draw the ornate frame; (d) .hh-fill-bonus red classified bad but it means POSITIVE clutch heat; (e) Hot Hand flames kept fixed because they match the JS-drawn hoop rim.

--plq-deep (2136, fallbacks at 1118, 1120, 2112) is one variable serving two roles: the plaque border (metal) and the .strap-info keycap extrusion (accent-edge). Split it when tokenizing, or accept that one role drives both.

Duplicated literals: the plaque glow radial is declared twice (2114 .plq-frame and 2158 #app button.daily-tile). The warm-black scrim rgb(30,22,8)/rgb(5,6,8) appears three times (1133, 1140, 1302). #6a5a3a appears 12 times, 11 as the fallback of var(--line, ...) where --line is never defined in :root, so the fallback always renders; defining --line (or --t-line) would reach all 11 at once. The 12th, .duel-toast border at 1535, is a bare literal.

Dormant CSS: the duel/arena/league block (1492-1565, 22 literals) styles markup from duel-ui.js, arena-ui.js and league-ui.js. app.js loads these on demand, but none of the three files is in the repo, so these selectors cannot render from this checkout. Theme them cheaply or drop them.

Runtime override caveat: app.js decorate3dButtons adds .presti-spin to every <button> not in BTN3D_EXCLUDE (a MutationObserver keeps it up). In this range that covers .daily-strip, .dt-act-share, .dt-act-ghost, .gate-back, #startDaily (.daily-tile), .duel-slot, .duel-qchip and .arena-chip. The flat, ghost and dashed treatments written for them compete with button.presti-spin (specificity 0,1,1) for border, background and box-shadow. The Daily tile defends itself with #app specificity; the others may render as keycaps. Check this on the live pages before assuming the treatments listed here are what users see.

NOT reachable from CSS: (1) the Hot Hand basketball and hoop are inline SVGs built in app.js ballLeverHtml(), at about lines 4438-4458, with hard-coded stop-color and stroke #ffcb84, #e8802a, #a64e10, #6e3208, #e6e0d2, #e0531a; (2) the fireworks and sprays (fireGoats, emojiSpray, supernovaErupt) are emoji glyphs, so their color comes from the platform emoji font; (3) HH_SEGMENTS picks heat classes lvl0-4 in JS, but the colors themselves live in CSS and are themeable; (4) no canvas drawing and no JS style.color or background writes touch the selectors in this range (the only nearby JS style write is a paper texture backgroundImage at app.js:2625, which belongs to another component).
